notes: expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The arrange asks with the watching checkbox unchecked (no Watcher row) and the act clicks the eye widget, so the Watcher + Question_Watchers inserts ARE the behavior under test. The unwatch direction was deliberately not chosen as a slice: Question.remove(Watcher) mutates an in-memory list, so unwatching only deletes the Question_Watchers join row (net zero in a before/after dump) while the Watcher row persists — no observable DB delta. Table list otherwise matches the ask-flow sibling. Join tables use tags_id/watchers_id, not Tag_id/Watcher_id. UserSession is deliberately excluded: auth plumbing, volatile by nature. ignore_columns are stripped from inserted/deleted rows and update comparisons by the capture tooling.
